# Monticello Gospel Assembly

> A nondenominational, Bible-led and Spirit-filled church in Lenexa, Kansas.

- Address: 9200 Hedge Lane Terrace, Lenexa, KS 66227
- Phone (call or text): (913) 669-3091
- Email: mga9200@gmail.com
- Sunday service: 11:00 AM
- Wednesday service: 7:30 PM
- Pastor: Tony Clark
- Giving: Venmo @MGALENEXA
- Church meal in the dining room after service, the last Sunday of the month (next one Nov 1)
- What people wear: suits and dresses. A children's class on Sundays. No steps at the entrance.
- Beliefs: the baptism of the Holy Ghost, speaking in tongues, the restoration of the body of Christ
